Capital

KAP-ih-tuhl · noun

Hear It

What It Means

Capital is the city where a government is based.

Sacramento is the capital of California.

Worked Example

On our class trip to the state capital, we watched lawmakers vote in the big domed building.

Lawmakers work there, so it is the city where the government meets. The government's home city is the capital.

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

headquarters

How Strong Is It? — City Hall → capital → National Capital

City Hall vs. capital

City Hall vs. capital: City hall is a smaller version: it is the home base for just one town's leaders.

National Capital vs. capital

National Capital vs. capital: A national capital, like Washington, D.C., is the biggest version - the home base for a whole country's government.

The pieces

root — capit

root — capit: head (Latin (caput, capitis))

suffix — al

suffix — al: the act or result of (builds a noun here) (Latin)

Put it together

Put it together: Capit- means head, and here -al builds a noun: the capital is the head city of a state or country.
